name: Sestao (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sestao (a factory and a steamship on yellow and blue).
history: In 2014 the council began a process to give the municipality its first official flag; after a public consultation and the municipal and foral procedure, the Juntas Generales de Bizkaia approved the flag in June 2016. The official design is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, green above and black below; the first flag, hoisted at the town hall on 1 October 2016, bore the municipal arms at the centre.
